summary: Members finish work on other bills before one debate can occupy the floor for weeks.
realLife: Mansfield got tax and farm legislation through before bringing up civil rights.
gates: Several bills are awaiting floor time.
inGame: needs: a floor calendar that records the sequence chosen by the floor manager.

turns.what: The leader brings up the disputed bill with routine measures still pending.
turns.pulledBy: The time available for the disputed bill is running out.
turns.writesBack: The routine measures remain on the calendar behind it.

turns.what: The chamber disposes of the tax bill and carries the farm bill over.
turns.pulledBy: Only the tax agreement is ready for a vote.
turns.writesBack: One pending item follows members into the long debate.
